Ararat 80, Waterville 55, CONY H.S. 51, Messalonskee 49, Leavitt Area 39, Morse 37, Winslow 30, Erskine 25; Men (17 events scored) Lewiston 124, Winslow 97, Leavitt 67, Mt. Ararat 66, Messalonskee 55, Cony 51, Waterville 42, Morse 12, Erskine 4. No Points column is printed in the rows. Wheelchair races (Boys 55 Meter Dash / 400 Meter Run / Shot Put Wheelchair, Schomaker, Leavitt) kept as events with 'Wheelchair' in the name. 26 status rows (SCR/DQ/NH, one XDQ relay) are not stored, as before; 11 J marks stripped (original in warnings). SCORE CHECK (all Women and Men totals reproduced exactly with 10-8-6-5-4-3-2-1 plus two sheet rules): the three Boys wheelchair events (lone entrant Schomaker, Leavitt) score 1 point each in the printed Leavitt 67, not 10; and Lewiston's 'B' 4x800 X11:03.13 (slower than Cony's 3rd 10:27.98) is counted as the 4th relay (5 points) in the printed Lewiston 124. Those two rules are the sheet's, not parse errors.
